name: SAP Testing Automation Framework (STAF)
description: SAP High Availability testing, evidence collection, and cluster triage for Azure SRE Agent. Provides 23 MCP tools covering workspace discovery, evidence collection, knowledge search, HA functional testing, and job/schedule management for SAP HANA, SCS, and Pacemaker clusters on Azure.
author: Microsoft

plugins.name: sap-cluster-triage
plugins.description: Triage SAP HANA and SCS Pacemaker cluster incidents — collects SSH evidence, queries the SAP knowledge base, and provides evidence context for LLM-driven root cause analysis and remediation.

plugins.name: setup-guide
plugins.description: Guide for setting up the SAP Testing Automation Framework environment — installation, Docker deployment, vars.yaml configuration, and Copilot integration.

plugins.name: test-runner
plugins.description: Execute STAF tests — run HA functional tests, configuration checks, and targeted test cases via direct Ansible execution or API mode.

plugins.name: test-result-analyzer
plugins.description: Analyze STAF test results and identify root causes — interpret test output, check test status, and read test logs.

plugins.name: workspace-creator
plugins.description: Create new SAP workspace configurations for STAF testing — onboard systems, generate hosts.yaml and sap-parameters.yaml.

plugins.name: workspace-validator
plugins.description: Validate SAP workspace configurations before running tests — check config structure, verify connectivity, troubleshoot setup issues.
